payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP over intervals/counts: dp[i][j] tracks ways to have last manual operation at i with j manual operations, using precomputed factorials and powers of 2 for transitions.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a 2D DP table indexed by (i, j) where i represents a position (segment boundary) and j counts manual operations. Transitions involve combinatorics (fac_inv, pow2). This matches dp_2d_state.
